final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.product_color AS color, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice_Line_Items i JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS s FROM g), r AS (SELECT g.color, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.s AS ratio FROM g JOIN t ON t.s IS NOT NULL WHERE g.cnt IS NOT NULL OR g.cnt IS NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS av FROM r), k AS (SELECT r.cnt, r.ratio, r.cnt - a.av AS diff FROM r JOIN a ON a.av IS NOT NULL WHERE r.cnt > a.av) SELECT AVG(cnt), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM k
